title: Best Genealogy Researchers (2026): Family Tree and Ancestry Help
description: How to hire a genealogy researcher for family trees, ancestry records, DNA result help or family history books: sources, privacy, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Genealogy researchers help trace family history: building family trees, searching birth, marriage and immigration records, interpreting DNA match lists and writing family history stories. Good research cites sources and separates facts from guesses. Projects go wrong when names are matched without evidence, private information about living people is shared carelessly, or researchers promise results that records cannot provide. This guide helps you research your family history carefully.
